xicbtn.n: Tooltip of the XIC button with several overlaid files; {n} = number of files.
zoom.mz: Text on the zoomed chart; {lo} and {hi} = ends in m/z.
zoom.rt: Text on the zoomed chart; {lo} and {hi} = ends in minutes.
xicbtn.apex: Line below the XIC created from the spectrum button; {rt} = apex RT (min), {y} = apex intensity.
xicbtn.ion.aria: Accessible name of the ion label next to the XIC button; {ion} = ion and window (e.g. m/z 301.1410 ± 5 ppm).
xicbtn.picked: Announcement after a peak is chosen in the spectrum; {ion} = ion and window.
xicbtn.pop.tol: Label of the tolerance field; {unit} = ppm (high resolution) or Da (unit resolution).
